ddl.name: installation_source

ddl.name: role_source

ddl.name: role_binding_source

ddl.where: "source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: schedule_source

ddl.where: "source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: network_policy_source

ddl.value: ("activated_at" IS NULL) = ("target_epoch" IS NULL) AND ("activated_at" IS NULL OR ("source_revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activated_at" >= "source_revoked_at"))
ddl.name: space_migration_activation

ddl.value: "outcome" IS NULL OR "outcome" <> 'succeeded' OR "activated_at" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: space_migration_success

ddl.value: "outcome" IS NULL OR "outcome" <> 'cancelled' OR ("activated_at" IS NULL AND "cancellation_requested_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: space_migration_cancel

ddl.value: ("started_at" IS NULL OR "started_at" >= "created_at") AND ("completed_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: space_migration_time

ddl.value: "source_revoked_at" IS NULL OR ("started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_revoked_at" >= "started_at")
ddl.name: space_migration_revoke_time

ddl.value: "completed_at" IS NULL OR (("started_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "started_at") AND ("activated_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "activated_at"))
ddl.name: space_migration_complete_time

ddl.value: ("placement" = 'automatic' AND "requested_primary_host_id" IS NULL) OR ("placement" = 'host' AND "requested_primary_host_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: space_placement

ddl.value: "outcome" IS NULL OR "outcome" <> 'succeeded' OR "activated_at" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: resource_migration_success

ddl.value: "outcome" IS NULL OR "outcome" <> 'cancelled' OR ("activated_at" IS NULL AND "cancellation_requested_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: resource_migration_cancel

ddl.value: ("started_at" IS NULL OR "started_at" >= "created_at") AND ("completed_at" IS NULL OR ("completed_at" >= "created_at" AND ("started_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "started_at") AND ("activated_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "activated_at")))
ddl.name: resource_migration_time

ddl.value: "verified_at" IS NULL OR ("target_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "verified_at" >= "started_at")
ddl.name: resource_migration_verification

ddl.value: "activated_at" IS NULL OR ("verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activated_at" >= "verified_at")
ddl.name: resource_migration_activation

ddl.value: "source_removed_at" IS NULL OR ("activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_removed_at" >= "activated_at")
ddl.name: resource_migration_cleanup

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: secret_source_detached

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: resource_source_detached

ddl.value: "requested_region_id" IS NULL OR "requested_provider" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: resource_requested_region

ddl.value: "region_id" IS NULL OR "provider" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: resource_region

ddl.value: "host_id" IS NULL OR "provider" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: resource_host

ddl.value:
("hosting" = 'platform' AND "provider" IS NOT NULL AND "host_id" IS NULL)
            OR ("hosting" = 'external' AND "provider" IS NOT NULL AND "remote" IS NOT NULL AND "host_id" IS NULL)
            OR ("hosting" = 'host' AND "host_id" IS NOT NULL AND "provider" IS NULL AND "provider_repository_id" IS NULL AND "remote" IS NULL)
ddl.name: repository_origin

ddl.value:
("hosting" IN ('platform', 'host') AND "authentication" IS NULL AND "connected_account_id" IS NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NULL AND "secret_id" IS NULL)
            OR ("hosting" = 'external' AND "authentication" IS NOT NULL AND (
                ("authentication" = 'anonymous' AND "connected_account_id" IS NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NULL AND "secret_id" IS NULL)
                OR ("authentication" = 'connection' AND "connected_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NULL AND "secret_id" IS NULL)
                OR ("authentication" = 'secret' AND "connected_account_id" IS NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_id" IS NOT NULL)))
ddl.name: repository_authentication

ddl.value:
("provider" IS NULL OR length("provider") > 0)
            AND ("provider_repository_id" IS NULL OR length("provider_repository_id") > 0)
ddl.name: repository_provider

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: installation_source_detached

ddl.value: "applied_generation" BETWEEN 0 AND "generation" AND (("applied_version" IS NULL AND "applied_generation" = 0) OR ("applied_version" IS NOT NULL AND "applied_generation" > 0))
ddl.name: installation_applied_generation

ddl.value: "commit" IS NULL OR (length("commit") IN (40, 64) AND ("commit" COLLATE "C") !~ '[^0-9a-f]')
ddl.name: repository_reference_commit

ddl.value: length("directory") > 0 AND substr("directory", 1, 1) <> '/' AND "directory" <> '..' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/..'
ddl.name: release_directory

ddl.value: length("directory") > 0 AND substr("directory", 1, 1) <> '/' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/../%' AND "directory" <> '..' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/..'
ddl.name: package_directory

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: package_policy_source_detached

ddl.value:
("scope" = 'account' AND "space_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("scope" = 'space' AND "space_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: package_policy_scope

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: role_source_detached

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: role_binding_source_detached

ddl.value: CAST("account_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) + CAST("group_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) + CAST("service_account_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) + CAST("account_service_account_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) = 1
ddl.name: role_binding_subject

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: schedule_source_detached

ddl.value: ("timing" = 'cron' AND "cron" IS NOT NULL AND "timezone" IS NOT NULL AND "interval" IS NULL) OR ("timing" = 'interval' AND "interval" > 0 AND "interval" IS NOT NULL AND "starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cron" IS NULL AND "timezone" IS NULL) OR ("timing" = 'once' AND "starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ends_at" IS NULL AND "cron" IS NULL AND "timezone" IS NULL AND "interval" IS NULL)
ddl.name: schedule_timing

ddl.value: "ends_at" IS NULL OR "starts_at" IS NULL OR "ends_at" > "starts_at"
ddl.name: schedule_end

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: network_policy_source_detached

ddl.value:
("scope" = 'account' AND "space_id" IS NULL AND "installation_id" IS NULL AND "workload" IS NULL) OR
        ("scope" = 'space' AND "space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation_id" IS NULL AND "workload" IS NULL) OR
        ("scope" = 'installation' AND "space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workload" IS NULL) OR
        ("scope" = 'workload' AND "space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workload" IS NOT NULL AND length("workload") > 0)
ddl.name: network_policy_scope

ddl.value: "retired_at" IS NULL OR "activated_at" IS NULL OR "retired_at" >= "activated_at"
ddl.name: deployment_times

ddl.value: "stopped_at" IS NULL OR "started_at" IS NULL OR "stopped_at" >= "started_at"
ddl.name: instance_times

ddl.value: length("directory") > 0 AND substr("directory", 1, 1) <> '/' AND "directory" <> '..' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/..'
ddl.name: space_configuration_directory

ddl.value: "outcome" IS NULL OR "outcome" <> 'succeeded' OR ("started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "error" IS NULL)
ddl.name: restoration_success

ddl.value: "completed_at" IS NULL OR "started_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "started_at"
ddl.name: restoration_finish

ddl.value: ("started_at" IS NULL OR "started_at" >= "created_at") AND ("completed_at" IS NULL OR "completed_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: restoration_time
